svg.text: Making useful products, learning to secure them.
I am a Software Engineering undergraduate at Universiti Malaysia Sabah.
My interests sit between product design, full-stack development and practical
application security. I learn best by turning an idea into something people
can use, then testing, refining and understanding how it really works.
Explore the work, follow the process, or get in touch.
